🇲🇽🌎 <u>Mexico Has Eliminated 88% of Its Ozone-Depleting HCFCs</u>

At the Montreal Protocol meeting in Kigali (MOP38, Nov 2–6), Semarnat undersecretary Ileana Villalobos reported that Mexico has cut its consumption of hydrochlorofluorocarbons 88% from its national baseline as of December 2025, with total elimination set for 2030. Since 2024 Mexico has run import quotas on HFCs under the Kigali Amendment, and in 2025 it finished converting its commercial refrigeration manufacturing to lower-impact alternatives.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>6,000 Paisano Vehicles Expected Through Nuevo Laredo for the Holidays</u>

Mexico's consulate in Laredo, Texas, is already preparing the December caravan: about 6,000 vehicles of Mexicans coming home from the US, matching last year. Registration is Dec 15 and the convoy leaves Dec 16 at 4 a.m., coordinated by the consulate, customs, migration and police. "Those who come to Mexico need certainty of security in their transit," said Consul Juan Carlos Mendoza Sánchez.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum Asks Immigration to Confirm Taddei and the Hernández Casillas Brothers Are Still in Mexico</u>

Rumors placed former INE chief Guadalupe Taddei in the US and INE contractors José Alfredo and Raymundo Hernández Casillas in South America. "Yes, it seems so," Sheinbaum said Friday when asked whether they remain in Mexico, but she asked the National Migration Institute (INM) for a formal report. On Lorenzo Córdova, who admitted he knew the firms existed: "Why didn't he do anything? And why did they contract more than 2 billion pesos?"

🇲🇽✊ "When a people knows its history and is empowered, the right: not here." "That's why people trust us. The day we betray, and there are no more well-being programs or the minimum wage no longer rises, then people will say: 'They sold out.' But that's not going to happen." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Nov 6, 2026 A reporter raised a children's cancer hospital in Ecatepec, State of Mexico: started in 2013 under the PRI state government, 689 million pesos spent, never opened. IMSS is taking over the project. Sheinbaum said the right still praises Seguro Popular without mentioning that it abandoned more than 80 hospitals, and quoted Monsiváis: its ideology "is hypocrisy." Then she listed why people trust the government: 13.5 million Mexicans out of poverty, the minimum wage up more than 154%, no gasoline or diesel price hikes while prices rose worldwide, and new hospitals, schools, trains and housing.

🔥🇲🇽 "The famous transition to democracy that everyone applauded was agreed with the United States." "And now we find out from Vicente Fox himself that yes, there was electoral fraud, that he took part, that he would never have handed the presidential sash to López Obrador." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Nov 6, 2026 Sheinbaum cited the book by Francisco Labastida, the PRI's 2000 presidential candidate: to get the US money he needed after the 1994 crisis, she said, Ernesto Zedillo agreed to the transition that brought Fox to power. Fox recently said in an interview that he would never have handed power to López Obrador in 2006. Asked about PAN leader Jorge Romero distancing the party from Fox, she said: "We always said Calderón was an illegitimate president, and we still maintain it, and now Fox proves us right."

text: 🇲🇽⚖️ "Who decided to concentrate all the power in the INE? The PRI, the PAN, the then-PRD, Movimiento Ciudadano, because Morena didn't exist." "It was part of what was called the Pact for Mexico. They privatize Pemex, they privatize CFE (...) and the new electoral reform, which concentrates in 11 people the decision of who is going to be in each state." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Nov 6, 2026 The 2014 electoral reform, born of Peña Nieto's Pact for Mexico, gave the INE's 11-member General Council the power to appoint the councilors of all 32 state electoral bodies, a job once done by state congresses. All but about two current state councilors were named by Lorenzo Córdova's council, she said. On Thursday, the Anti-Corruption Ministry traced more than 2 billion pesos in state electoral contracts from 2014 to 2023 to the Hernández Casillas brothers' companies.
banner: "WHO PUT ALL THE POWER IN THE INE?"
